signature: PETRVS GOLTBECK ME FECIT M K COTBVS 35 (M K = “musicus comunis” [“town musician”]); initials “H M K A” and “A S D V S 35.”
dimensions: : bo1 11.3, bo2 11.6, be 122, le 3538, int. diam. of mouthpipe 13.6.¹
literature: Kinsky 1913: 199, Tafel 30 (photo); Heyde 1980a: 184; Fischer 1984: 45; SmithD 1989: 30; MyersA 1998.
